description.p: Phodder subscribes to podcasts, downloads new episodes in the background and plays them from a queue ordered by group.

ul.li: Groups put daily shows ahead of the rest
Download filters and automatic chapter skipping per podcast
Sync with Nextcloud GPodder Sync
Pauses for calls and resumes when Bluetooth reconnects
In Library, selecting episodes counts and acts on only the episodes the current filter shows.
A podcast's Episodes tab can select one page or every episode, and selections on other pages count.
Downloading more than 20 selected episodes asks first.
The Refresh button turns smoothly instead of wobbling.
Playback resumes after a call you didn't answer.
Select several episodes at once to download, queue, mark, or delete them together. Long press or right click an episode, or use the Select button.
Podcasts can have their own playback speed. Changing the speed while one plays lasts for that episode.
Trim silence shortens long pauses, for every podcast or only some.
Back up your library to a file and restore it, from the main menu.
Play an episode before subscribing, from a podcast's preview in Add Podcast.
Calls pause playback on every modem, including a second SIM.
A sync problem's Details open Settings at the Sync section.
When the audio output isn't ready, such as a car still connecting, Phodder tries the episode again instead of skipping to the next one.
Switching off a car stereo pauses the episode instead of unloading it.
The Refresh button turns while podcasts are refreshing.
Delete All Files in History works, says how many files it deleted, and is unavailable when there's nothing to delete.
Missing podcast and episode artwork is downloaded again.
A failing gPodder or Nextcloud sync shows in the problem bar until it works again.
Playing with nothing loaded resumes the episode you were listening to, not whatever is first in the queue.
Headset and media-key previous and next buttons skip back and forward; press twice to restart the episode or move to the next one.
A stray previous press from a headset no longer restarts the episode.
Phodder steps aside from headset and media-key buttons while another player is playing, so they control that player.
A lighter mini player, matching Paradon's.
The app icon's play button is now slate with a white outline.
Phodder no longer leaves a hidden window running in the background.
Phodder in the background gives memory back after refreshing large feeds.
The player keeps showing the episode when a Bluetooth device disconnects.
The app icon is taller, to match other icons of its shape.

description.p: Quit now also stops Phodder in the background.

ul.li: A queue ordered by group, so daily shows come first
Background refreshes and downloads, with filters and expiry per podcast
Chapters, automatic chapter skipping and transcripts
Sync with Nextcloud GPodder Sync and gpodder.net
Pauses for calls and resumes when Bluetooth reconnects
